purpose: Provide deterministic, minimum-necessary context acquisition for agents so repository memory can grow without requiring full-repository rereads.

architecture.description: Use for architecture, Twin, Evidence Graph, Capability Graph, domains or system-boundary tasks.

governance.description: Use for scope, rules, lifecycle, artifact or policy changes.

nvidia.description: Use for NVIDIA Inception, NVIDIA technology fit, workload evaluation and pitch claims.

pitch.description: Use for pitch-deck content and claims. Design must remain downstream of evidence.
pitch.rule: Do not invent missing customer, market, traction, benchmark or partnership values.

agent_design.description: Use for agent roles, permissions, context contracts and behavior.

memory_rules: Load the smallest relevant context bundle after bootstrap.
Treat README as orientation, not as the sole authority for governed semantics.
Do not infer missing evidence from architecture or vision documents.
When a new governed file materially changes context routing, publish a new manifest version.
Do not store secrets, credentials or raw sensitive personal data in agent memory artifacts.
known_gaps: No roadmap registry artifact yet beyond scope phase sequence.
No NVIDIA application scope artifact yet.
